description: A typed, onion-model middleware system for Next.js App Router route handlers, server actions, form actions and pages, plus a generated typed client for routes.
rules: Every server entry point goes through a pipe: routePipe<RouteContext<"/path">>(), actionPipe(schema?), formActionPipe(schema?), pagePipe<PageProps<"/path">>(), layoutPipe<LayoutProps<"/path">>(), templatePipe(). Never write a bare handler or action.

Subpath imports are strict and there is no root export: pipes from @flefebvre/next-pipe/pipes; next, interrupt, success, error, json from /server; callRoute, useApiCall, getActionError from /client; middlewares from /middlewares and /middlewares/routes.
Route handlers return { status, json } via the json(status, body) helper, never a raw Response or NextResponse. ResponseMiddleware, which routePipe() wires in for you, performs the conversion.
Route interrupts and manual returns need `as const` (the json() helper applies it). Without it, status widens to number and the generated client's response union stops discriminating.

Interrupt in the surface's dialect: routes use interrupt({ status, json } as const); actions and form actions use interrupt(error(key, data)); pages, layouts and templates use redirect() or notFound(), which throw and need no interrupt.

A middleware is a class extending BeforeMiddleware, AfterMiddleware or Middleware. before() returns next({ ... }) to merge typed values into the handler input, or interrupt(value) to short-circuit. after() runs in reverse order.

A middleware declares its dependency on an earlier one by typing its before() parameter, e.g. before(arg: { user: SafeUser }). Composing it too early is then a compile error rather than a runtime bug.
Re-run codegen (`next-pipe gen`) after adding, removing or moving routes, verbs or path params. Body and query type changes flow through `import type` automatically and need no re-run.
Generated builders and barrel members carry the verb verbatim, uppercase: routes.api.notes(id).like.POST(); definition.method is
Client code imports only from @flefebvre/next-pipe/client and the generated routes barrel, never from /server, /pipes or middleware files.
zod is an optional peer dependency, needed only by the validation middlewares and by actionPipe(schema)/formActionPipe(schema). The schemaless actionPipe()/formActionPipe() work without it.
Requires Next.js >= 16 (App Router), React >= 19, TypeScript >= 5 and Node >= 22. RouteContext, PageProps and LayoutProps are Next.js-generated globals and need no import.
This package follows semver: breaking changes only in major versions. If a snippet does not typecheck, trust the installed package's .d.ts in node_modules over the docs.
